description: This file defines data structures and functions for decoding Gateway setup information from JSON or Base64-encoded JSON strings. It includes a struct to hold payload data and an enum with static methods for decoding logic.

classes.name: GatewaySetupPayload
classes.description: A Codable struct that holds optional properties related to Gateway setup configuration such as URL, host, port, TLS status, bootstrap token, token, and password.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a raw string into a GatewaySetupPayload by attempting JSON decoding directly or decoding Base64-encoded JSON.

methods.name: decodeFromJSON
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a GatewaySetupPayload object.

methods.name: decodeBase64Payload
methods.description: Decodes a Base64-encoded string into a JSON string, normalizing and padding as necessary.
